calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
SELECT count(*) AS return_rows, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS distinct_sales_lines,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quantity_returned<=0 OR r.refund_net<=0) AS nonpos,
  min(r.return_date) AS min_ret, max(r.return_date) AS max_ret,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.sales_line_id IS NULL) AS orphan
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN sold USING (sales_line_id)
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format, p.category, f.staff_purchase_flag
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_ret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       count(*) AS lines, SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id=999) AS n999, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.category='ZZ Test') AS ntest,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.qty_ret > l.quantity OR r.refund_net > l.net_amount + 0.01) AS over_returned,
       count(DISTINCT l.store_id) AS stores
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.status, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sold_net,
  count(r.return_line_id) AS returns, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS refund,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch,
  min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT format) AS formats, min(format) AS f1, max(format) AS f2
FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format) > 1 OR store_id >= 900

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, s.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY l.format
